design: Five preselected four-ply opening positions, paired colors; three isolated pair jobs in parallel. Same Stockfish 19 at 5000 nodes, MultiPV=3, 35cp shortlist. Selector=random. All ten games are new; earlier smoke games excluded.

analysis.interpretation: Exploratory only: five fixed opening pairs, selector=random. Ten games cannot separate small strength differences; compare per-decision referee scores across arms.
